categories.main_business_segments: Chenbro primarily operates in the design, manufacturing, and sales of computer and server chassis and related components. Its product portfolio includes desktop PC chassis, industrial computer chassis, server chassis, and computer peripheral equipment. The company also engages in import and export trade of computer products and peripherals.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: Chenbro utilizes advanced modular design (modular design 2.0) and precision manufacturing techniques including stamping, injection molding, semi-automatic riveting, welding, and powder coating. The company emphasizes low-cost intelligent manufacturing (LCIM), quality management systems (QMS), and integrates AI, storage, 5G, and edge computing technologies into its product development. It also focuses on liquid cooling technologies for high-performance server cooling solutions.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The company serves major cloud service providers (CSPs) and telecom operators, including leading global data center builders and AI server users. Key customers include large cloud service companies such as Amazon AWS, Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud, and Meta. Chenbro targets markets requiring high-performance computing, AI training, edge computing, and storage solutions.
categories.geographic_coverage: Chenbro operates globally with significant sales in the United States (46%), China (37%), Europe (7%), Taiwan (6%), and other regions (4%). It has manufacturing and assembly facilities in Taiwan, the United States, Malaysia, China (Kunshan and Jinan), and subsidiaries in Europe and the USA, supporting a global supply chain and customer base.
categories.supply_chain_position: Chenbro operates primarily in the midstream segment of the server supply chain, focusing on chassis design and manufacturing. It integrates upstream components such as processors, memory modules, power supplies, and cooling modules into its chassis solutions and collaborates closely with ODMs and system integrators downstream. The company acts as a key integrator linking upstream component suppliers and downstream cloud service providers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes R&D in AI-ready server chassis, modular design, liquid cooling technologies, and edge computing solutions. It invests 2%-4% of annual revenue in R&D, focusing on innovation in high-density storage, high-speed flash storage, and support for next-generation CPUs and GPUs. Chenbro collaborates with industry leaders like NVIDIA, AMD, and Intel to develop cutting-edge server solutions and emphasizes sustainable design and global localized manufacturing.
categories.revenue_model: Chenbro generates revenue primarily through product sales of server chassis and related components. It operates multiple business models including joint design manufacturing (JDM/ODM), off-the-shelf (OTS) products, and OEM Plus value-added services. Revenue is driven by customized solutions for cloud service providers and telecom operators, with a focus on high-value AI and edge computing server products.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Chenbro is positioned as a global leader in server chassis and mechanical-electrical integration solutions, competing with other ODM and OEM manufacturers in the server industry. It differentiates itself through modular design capabilities, close partnerships with major chip and GPU vendors, and a strong presence in AI and edge server markets. The company leverages its global manufacturing footprint and customer-centric customization to maintain competitive advantage.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, Chenbro achieved record revenue exceeding NT$14.5 billion with server shipments reaching approximately 1.79 million units. The company has demonstrated steady growth driven by strong demand for AI and general-purpose servers. R&D investment remains stable at 2%-4% of revenue, supporting ongoing innovation and market expansion. The company’s global manufacturing expansion and strategic partnerships underpin its growth trajectory.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Chenbro offers highly modular, customizable server chassis solutions that support high-density, high-performance computing needs including AI and edge applications. Its products incorporate advanced cooling technologies such as liquid cooling and are designed for compatibility with next-generation CPUs, GPUs, and storage devices. The company emphasizes rapid prototyping, flexible manufacturing, and sustainable design practices, positioning itself as a preferred partner for leading cloud service providers seeking innovative, reliable, and efficient server infrastructure.
